description: This file defines models and methods related to analytic journal billing rates, including classes for rate grid, account extension, timesheet extension, and invoice extension, with methods for handling onchange events and analytic line retrieval.

classes.name: analytic_journal_rate_grid
classes.description: Relation table between journals and billing rates

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Extension of account.analytic.account with invoicing rate relations

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Extension of hr.analytic.timesheet with onchange handlers for account and journal IDs

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension of account.invoice with method to get analytic lines and set to_invoice based on journal and account

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Handles onchange event for account_id, updates to_invoice based on related rate grid

methods.name: on_change_journal_id
methods.description: Handles onchange event for journal_id, updates to_invoice based on related rate grid

methods.name: _get_analytic_lines
methods.description: Retrieves analytic lines and sets to_invoice based on journal and account relations
